|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 of [[Bespin (V)]] (version 2 of 4). The image here is the slip on the Virtual Set 23 release sheet with errata (Set-23-Plus-Errata.pdf) (PDF created 2 August 2024), cut unchanged from page 3. The current text is [[Bespin (V) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source. Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). A slip on a Players Committee release sheet and the PC card image are separate publications, so each is its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: “a change is a change”).
* '''Original''' ([[Bespin (V)]]): the card image in the cited repository revision<ref name="ht-335d47f">Players Committee card image, [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/335d47f6b929debedbac9376b863af4442469f36/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Dark/hires/bespin.png as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository; later publisher image at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual23-Dark/large/bespin.gif res.starwarsccg.org] in commit [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/335d47f6b929debedbac9376b863af4442469f36 335d47f] “Set 23 new images”, 20 July 2024.</ref> prints: “Light Side: You lose no more than 2 Force to Cloud City Occupation. Game text of opponent’s Admiral’s Orders is canceled. Dark Side: If you occupy and Dark Deal on table, flip This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time. Immune to Revolution.”<ref name="cj-753083f">Dating evidence only: the PC card data [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/git/commits/753083fc81fb2db289a978f23181e87ee0f181c2 swccg-card-json commit 753083f] “Set 23” (21 July 2024) first gave the card this wording.</ref> The card image prints no errata mark.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 23 release sheet with errata (Set-23-Plus-Errata.pdf)<ref name="sheet23-20240802">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-23-Plus-Errata.pdf Virtual Set 23 release sheet with errata] (PDF, 9 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, July 2024”; file created 2 August 2024). Released with [[Virtual Set 23]] (22 July 2024); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 3, file created 2 August 2024: “'''Light Side:''' You lose no more than 2 Force to Cloud City Occupation. Game text of opponent's Admiral's Orders is canceled. '''Dark Side:''' If you occupy and Dark Deal on table, flip This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time. Immune to Revolution.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Bespin (V)]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[Bespin (V)]] (repository revision 21 July 2024) as a printable slip under the label “•Bespin (DARK)”, pixel for pixel the same except that the picture area is left blank (white), so the slip can be laid over the picture of the card named in its lower-left corner ([[Bespin (Dark)]]). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Bespin (V) (Errata 2)]]): the errata card image (7 December 2025, for the PC's Set 26 errata and art updates)<ref name="ht-462fb5e">Players Committee card image, [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/462fb5e5bf3d0fa5a0a3f4a9bff595708ec5dfce/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Dark/large/bespin.gif as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (served at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual23-Dark/large/bespin.gif res.starwarsccg.org]) in commit [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/462fb5e5bf3d0fa5a0a3f4a9bff595708ec5dfce 462fb5e] “Set 26 Errata and Art Updates”, 7 December 2025, for the PC's Set 26 errata and art updates.</ref> prints: “Light Side: You lose no more than 2 Force to Cloud City Occupation. May not be converted. Dark Side: Executor may not move from here unless Vader aboard. If your [Cloud City] objective on table, Executor deploys -8 here.”<ref name="cj-34e6c8a">Dating evidence only: the PC card data [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/git/commits/34e6c8a6e9a00468b0833c8657c30b52ef5641b5 swccg-card-json commit 34e6c8a] “Set 26 Errata” (5 December 2025) changed the card to this wording.</ref> '''What changed:''' Dark Side: “If you occupy and Dark Deal on table, flip This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time. Immune to Revolution.” was replaced by “Executor may not move from here unless Vader aboard. If your [Cloud City] objective on table, Executor deploys -8 here.” Light Side: “Game text of opponent’s Admiral’s Orders is canceled.” was replaced by “May not be converted.” The picture of Bespin was also replaced with new artwork. The card image prints the errata mark “E1” at bottom right.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Bespin (V) (Errata 3)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 26 release sheet with errata (Set-26-Errata-Combined.pdf)<ref name="sheet26-20251226">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-26-Errata-Combined.pdf Virtual Set 26 release sheet with errata] (PDF, 5 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, December 2025”; file created 26 December 2025). Released with [[Virtual Set 26]] (8 December 2025); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 5, file created 26 December 2025: “'''Light Side:''' You lose no more than 2 Force to Cloud City Occupation. May not be converted. '''Dark Side:''' ''Executor'' may not move from here unless Vader aboard. If your [Cloud City] objective on table, ''Executor'' deploys -8 here.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Bespin (V) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[Bespin (V) (Errata 2)]] (repository revision 7 December 2025) as a printable slip under the label “•Bespin (DARK)”; the printed face matches the image in visible printed details; the sheet omits the top padding and uses different image encoding. A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints “E1” but is errata 3 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
